caption:
A big week in the water, and Toto's upper back is letting her know. Paddling loads the lats, upper traps, rotator cuff and the muscles between the shoulder blades, so stiffness through the upper back and neck is really common.

Remedial massage can help those areas feel easier and make moving more comfortable, especially on a rest day. It complements, rather than replaces, land-based strength work like band rotations and rows, two or three times a week.

Weakness lifting your arm, painful clicking or pins and needles down the arm are worth a physio or GP assessment first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio know what surfing asks of your shoulders. Book online via the link in bio.
